title: CivicGov
summary: A Drupal 10 municipal portal with a planted custom module (civicgov_tools): an anonymous citizen-lookup route that concatenates ?id straight into SQL (SQLi) and dumps seeded citizen PII, plus a token-guarded maintenance route that shell_execs ?cmd (RCE) onto an app host where www-data has NOPASSWD sudo find for a trivial root privesc.

cmd: PGPASSWORD=civicgov-db-2024 psql -U civicgov -d civicgov -h 127.0.0.1 -tAc 'SELECT email FROM civicgov_citizens ORDER BY id'
loot.description: seeded citizen benefit-record PII (name, national id, email, address, benefit status) in the civicgov_citizens table, dumpable via the module SQLi or directly in the DB
the planted vulnerable custom-module source: the lookup route concatenates ?id into the SQL string instead of using Drupal's placeholder API
the installed Drupal front page, proving the CivicGov portal booted and seeded
